name: Digit Robotics
summary: Digit Robotics is dedicated to large-scale commercial deployment of AGI robots. It focuses on multimodal interactive foundation-model algorithms and intelligent hardware for humanoid robots, covering the full process from design, research and development to production and commercial application. Its products include general-purpose humanoid robots for interactive services, lifelike humanoid robots, character-IP robots and embodied intelligent interaction platforms. Core services include sales and support for complete humanoid robots based on its own intellectual property, custom development based on customers' intellectual property, and support for joint operations and expansion.
